invariants.rationale: Non-null Option values are generally returned for method exit points indicating presence or absence of the expected value.
indexInstantTime is likely required to perform the index operation, so it is expected to be non-null.
context is expected to be a mandatory execution parameter and thus non-null at method exit.
If Option is not empty, get() should provide a non-null HoodieIndexCommitMetadata object.
result is defined as an Option type, so this should always hold.
